text.tspan: Setup, sign-in and daily tooling should feel like the same product, with clear state and predictable actions.
Lead Developer / Product Manager - Marcin Kordyaczny
Visible focus and a clear recovery path
An access screen may pair an unframed form with an
identity area. Keep the form's heading, labels,
validation and recovery link together. On narrow
screens, the working form takes priority; the artwork
must not push it below the fold.
Provide default, hover, focus, loading, disabled and
error states. Use established icons and accessible
names for tool actions. Keep control dimensions
stable. Use 4 px corner radii for controls and at most
Errors identify the affected field and a recovery
action without clearing valid input. Loading must not
duplicate submissions. Never make recovery depend
on knowing the forgotten password. The sample is
visual direction, not a working UI.
